_comment: What MONITORING can do, by capability. status: car = done and confirmed on this car; built = in the tool, not yet confirmed on the car; missing = not yet. Each example in cases.json lists the capabilities it needs; tools/scenario_coverage.mjs prints which examples can be answered. Change a status only with the evidence named in `where`.

dme.speed.what: speed from block 19 (v, v_asc), the standstill preflight
dme.speed.where: src/lib/vehicleState.ts; TUNER reads block 19 on the car

dme.ram.what: DME master-window RAM reads in a PROBE plan
dme.ram.where: src/lib/probe/executor.ts; TUNER reads them on the car

dme.torque-intervention.what: named RAM addresses for ASC/MSR torque requests and the torque actually delivered
dme.torque-intervention.where: needs names from the disassembly notes (tuner_ram)

smg.faults.what: SMG II fault read with its own FS_LESEN frame, kept as bytes

smg.faults.decode.where: needs the car's answer and the SGBD's result table

smg.live.what: SMG II live values (pressure, pump, clutch, gear)

smg.adaptations.what: SMG II adaptation values (ADAPTIONSWERTE_LESEN takes an argument)

dsc.faults.what: DSC fault read with its own FS_LESEN frame, kept as bytes

dsc.sensors.what: DSC sensor status: steering angle, yaw rate, lateral acceleration, pressure
dsc.sensors.where: DSC telegrams collapse to 56 04 00 52 (static scrape); needs the SGBD execution trace

probe.run.what: a plan of reads run by the tab, parked/moving aware

probe.capture.what: captures around moments a condition holds

probe.judge.what: judgements computed by the tab, with provenance

probe.screen.what: PROBE started on the screen, stopped from the hub, and its one line there

cowork.store.what: CO-WORK kept on the device, every write checked by the rules

cowork.sync.what: an investigation's CO-WORK sent to the owner's account and read by the desk

records.sync.what: read records sent to the owner's account

bridge.what: Matrix MONITORING tools on the tab
bridge.where: src/lib/bridge/handlers.ts, functions/api/bridge/; against a stand-in relay 2026-10-27. Relay 0.11.0 built, not deployed

stage.screen.what: monitoring_stage: put a non-read job on the screen

ledger.grant.what: the owner clears a read for a moving car, on the screen
ledger.grant.where: src/lib/ledger.ts grantMovingOk exists; the screen does not

service.run.what: actuator tests and procedures on a vehicle, run by a person on the screen

tuning.handoff.what: the map change itself, in TUNER
